title: Faint Submillimeter Galaxies Revealed by Multifield Deep ALMA Observations: Number Counts, Spatial Clustering, and a Dark Submillimeter Line Emitter
question: What are the 1.2 mm number counts and clustering (galaxy bias) of faint (0.1-1 mJy) SMGs in multifield deep ALMA maps, and what is a serendipitous line emitter (SLE-1)?

what.value: Bright SMG ALMA catalog (91 sources, SNR>4) for >1 mJy counts

evidence.quote: We use $91$ sources whose SNRs are higher than $4.0$ in Table 3 and Table 4 of (cite: hodge2013).

what.value: Faint SMG counts from SXDS ALMA catalog

evidence.quote: We also construct the differential number counts using the source catalog of (cite: hatsukade2013)

what.value: EBL at 1.2 mm from COBE FIRAS: 21.1 Jy/deg2

evidence.quote: the EBL at 1.2 mm has been estimated to be $21.1^{+4.4}_{-4.6}$ Jy deg$^{-2}$
we use a redshift distribution of SMGs obtained by follow-up spectroscopic observations (cite: chapman2005).

recipe.goal: Extract sources and apply SNR cut
recipe.method: SExtractor on maps before PB correction; negative maps for spurious fraction; keep peak SNR>4
key_parameters: 6 contiguous pixels above 1.8 sigma; final SNR>4.0

recipe.method: Inject flux-scaled synthesized beams (SNR 2-9) at random positions, re-extract; deboost by S_out/S_in
xi(S)=(1-fc)/(C Aeff), summed in bins of dlogS=0.2, scaled to 1; Poisson errors
assumptions: Modified blackbody beta=1.5, Td=35 K at z=2.5 for flux/SFR scaling

recipe.goal: Fit Schechter and double power law; integrate EBL
recipe.method: chi2 minimization to counts (this work, Hatsukade, Hodge/Karim), integrate S*phi
b_g^2 ≈ (sigma_N^2 - Nbar)/(Nbar^2 sigma_V^2) from field-to-field scatter; halo mass from Sheth-Tormen bias
key_parameters: flux limit 0.25 mJy with factor-2 flux uncertainty
assumptions: Redshift distribution of Chapman+2005 (mean z~2.5); one-to-one galaxy-halo

recipe.goal: Blind line search and interpretation of SLE-1
recipe.method: 100 km/s binned cube of Map 1 SPW; negative-source check; compare expected 1.2 mm continuum from line-derived LIR to upper limit; SED templates and multiwavelength limits
assumptions: M82 CO ladder; Iono+2009 L'CO-LIR relation; Td=35 K, beta=1.5

evidence.quote: In the $10$ ALMA maps, we detect eleven SMGs with SNRs of $4.1-6.1$.

answer_key.quantity: Integrated flux density down to 0.1 mJy

evidence.quote: The integrated flux density down to the survey limit, $S_{\rm limit} = 0.1$ mJy, is calculated to be $\simeq 11$ Jy deg$^{-2}$
we obtain an $1\sigma$ upper limit of the galaxy bias of $b_{\rm g} < 4$.

answer_key.quantity: Dark halo mass of faint SMGs

evidence.quote: we estimate the dark halo mass of the faint SMGs to be roughly $\lesssim 7 \times 10^{12} M_\odot$.
The flux of the detected line is calculated to be $(1.36 \pm 0.19) \times 10^{-1}$ Jy km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: SLE-1 3 sigma 1.2 mm continuum upper limit

evidence.quote: The $3 \sigma$ upper limit on the $1.2$ mm continuum flux density of SLE–1 is estimated to be $64$ $\mu$Jy.

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and imaging parameters (weighting, robust, cell, size, cleaning)
Continuum channel selection and line-free channels
Archival project-to-map mapping and details of archival reductions
Number of artificial sources and trials in completeness simulations
Line search algorithm for the cube
missing_for_reproduction: Mapping of project codes to maps
score_reason: Public data and clear counting recipe, but imaging parameters missing and some data unpublished.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric counts, but imaging details are partly missing.
